title: ranxianglei/billion-context
summary: A fast-rising context-compression plugin designed to support very long agent sessions within smaller context windows. The project claims substantial token savings by folding older material while keeping active work available.
friendlySummary: This plugin tries to keep long AI sessions useful by shrinking older context instead of sending every past message again.
whyItMatters: Agent developers can study or trial its approach to long-lived sessions, especially when raw conversation history is becoming expensive. Treat the savings as project claims to benchmark on your own workload, and note the repository’s additional attribution term.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it when long sessions are becoming costly, but measure the results yourself and read the licence and attribution rules first.
